cgu.seo.title: Terms of Service — Cadence
cgu.seo.description: Rules for accessing and using Cadence: account, free plan and paid subscriptions, obligations, and cancellation.
cgu.page.title: Terms of Service and Sale
cgu.s1.heading: 1. Purpose
cgu.s1.p: These terms govern access to and use of Cadence, an appointment management app that lets you create time slots, associate contacts with them, and send confirmation links. Creating an account constitutes unreserved acceptance of these terms.
cgu.s2.heading: 2. Account
cgu.s2.p: The account is personal. You are responsible for the confidentiality of your credentials and for any activity carried out from your account. The information provided must be accurate and kept up to date.
cgu.s3.heading: 3. Plans and pricing
cgu.s3.plans.free: up to {{contacts}} contacts and {{appointments}} appointments sent per calendar month.
cgu.s3.plans.basic: up to {{contacts}} contacts and {{appointments}} appointments per month.
cgu.s3.plans.standard: up to {{contacts}} contacts and {{appointments}} appointments per month, full calendar (week/month view), and self-service booking.
cgu.s3.plans.economic: up to {{contacts}} contacts and {{appointments}} appointments per month, plus the monthly trend.
cgu.s3.plans.business: unlimited contacts and appointments, custom invite link (branding, message, Google reviews, website), no commitment period.
cgu.s3.payment_p: Payment is monthly, by card, via our payment provider. Access to the chosen tier is activated as soon as payment is confirmed and renews automatically at each due date until cancelled.
cgu.s3.referral_p: : available from the Free-mium plan. Each user has a unique referral link. If the referred person subscribes to a paid plan, the referrer receives 30% of the amount paid each month, for as long as the referee remains subscribed. Withdrawal is possible from €25 of available balance, processed manually.
cgu.s4.heading: 4. Cancellation and refunds
cgu.s4.p: The subscription can be cancelled at any time from the billing area. Access to the paid tier remains active until the end of the already-paid period, then the account reverts to the free plan. In accordance with Article L221-28 of the French Consumer Code, immediate performance of the digital service with express agreement entails waiving the 14-day right of withdrawal for the current period.
cgu.s5.heading: 5. Prohibited uses
cgu.s5.list: Sending unwanted solicitations or unlawful content via invitation links.
Adding third parties' personal data without a legal basis or informing the person concerned.
Unauthorized access attempts, reverse engineering, deliberate overloading of the service.
cgu.s5.p: Any breach may result in account suspension or deletion, without refund of amounts due for the current period.
cgu.s6.heading: 6. Availability and liability
cgu.s6.p: The Service is provided "as is", with a best-efforts obligation. The publisher cannot be held liable for missed appointments, lost opportunities, or indirect damages resulting from unavailability, an undelivered email, or a data entry error.
cgu.s7.heading: 7. Personal data
cgu.s7.p: Data processing is described in the privacy policy. By entering your contacts' data, you guarantee that you have a legal basis to do so and that you inform the individuals concerned.
cgu.s8.heading: 8. Changes and applicable law
cgu.s8.p: These terms may be amended; users are informed of substantial changes before they take effect. French law applies. Failing an amicable agreement, the French courts have jurisdiction.
confidentialite.seo.title: Privacy Policy (GDPR) — Cadence
confidentialite.seo.description: Data collected, purposes, legal bases, retention periods, and GDPR rights for Cadence users and guests.
confidentialite.page.title: Privacy Policy (GDPR)
confidentialite.s1.heading: 1. Data controller
confidentialite.s1.p: Cadence's publisher is the controller for data related to account creation and the operation of the Service. For the data you enter about your contacts and appointments, you act as data controller and Cadence acts as processor within the meaning of Article 28 of the GDPR.
confidentialite.s2.heading: 2. Data collected

confidentialite.s2.list.label: Account
confidentialite.s2.list.text: email, display name, encrypted password or authentication provider ID (Google), creation date.

confidentialite.s2.list.label: Business profile
confidentialite.s2.list.text: business name, invite message, Google Business/Maps links, rating, and number of reviews shown.

confidentialite.s2.list.label: Contacts
confidentialite.s2.list.text: name, email, phone, notes, birthday, city, address, country, languages, hobbies, family situation, number of children, gender.

confidentialite.s2.list.label: Appointments
confidentialite.s2.list.text: title, date, time, duration, location, notes, status, invite token, and timestamp of the guest's response.

confidentialite.s2.list.label: Billing
confidentialite.s2.list.text: customer and subscription IDs from the payment provider, subscription status. No card data is stored by Cadence.

confidentialite.s2.list.label: Technical
confidentialite.s2.list.text: connection and security logs, theme preference, cookie consent choices.

confidentialite.s3.heading: 3. Purposes and legal bases
confidentialite.s3.list: Providing the Service (calendar, contacts, confirmation links) — performance of the contract.
Sending invitation and confirmation emails — performance of the contract and the legitimate interest of the appointment organizer.
Managing the Pro subscription and billing — performance of the contract and legal accounting obligation.
Security, abuse prevention, and logging — legitimate interest.
Audience measurement and marketing communications — consent, revocable at any time.
confidentialite.s4.heading: 4. Recipients and processors
confidentialite.s4.p: Data is accessible to the publisher and its technical processors, only to the extent necessary for their services: application hosting and managed database, transactional email service, payment provider for subscriptions. No data is sold or transferred to third parties for advertising purposes.
confidentialite.s5.heading: 5. Transfers outside the EU
confidentialite.s5.p: Data is hosted within the European Union. Where a processor handles data outside the EU, the transfer is governed by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or an adequacy decision.
confidentialite.s6.heading: 6. Retention periods
confidentialite.s6.list: Account and associated content: for the entire lifetime of the account.
After account deletion: erased within 30 days, excluding encrypted backups purged within 90 days.
Invoices and accounting records: 10 years (legal obligation).
Technical and security logs: 12 months maximum.
confidentialite.s7.heading: 7. People invited to an appointment
confidentialite.s7.p: A person receiving an invitation link accesses a limited public page: appointment title, date, time, location, and organizer information. Their response (acceptance or decline) is recorded with its date. They may request deletion of their data directly from the organizer who added them as a contact, or write to us to be guided.
confidentialite.s8.heading: 8. Your rights
confidentialite.s8.p: In accordance with Articles 15 to 22 of the GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict, object, and port your data, as well as the right to withdraw your consent at any time. These rights can be exercised from your account or by email at the contact address. A complaint can be filed with the CNIL (cnil.fr) or your local data protection authority.
confidentialite.s9.heading: 9. Security
confidentialite.s9.p: Exchanges are encrypted in transit (TLS), passwords are hashed, data access is isolated per user at the database level through row-level security rules, and invitation tokens are random and limited-use.
confidentialite.s10.heading: 10. Cookies
confidentialite.s10.p: Details of the trackers used and how to manage your preferences can be found on the Cookies page.
cookies.seo.title: Cookie Policy — Cadence
cookies.seo.description: List of cookies and trackers used by Cadence, their purpose, duration, and how to change your consent at any time.
cookies.page.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.s1.heading: What is a cookie?
cookies.s1.p: A cookie is a small file placed on your device when you visit a website. Cadence also uses browser local storage, subject to the same rules. Non-essential trackers are only set after your explicit consent, in accordance with GDPR.
cookies.s2.heading: Trackers used
cookies.table.name: Tracker

cookies.rows.name: Authentication session
cookies.rows.purpose: Keep you signed in and secure your requests.

cookies.rows.name: Theme preference
cookies.rows.purpose: Remember the light or dark mode chosen.

cookies.rows.name: Cookie consent
cookies.rows.purpose: Store your choices so the banner isn't shown again.

cookies.rows.name: Analytics
cookies.rows.purpose: Aggregated usage statistics to improve the product.

cookies.s3.heading: Manage your consent
cookies.s3.p: You can change or withdraw your choice at any time. Declining optional trackers does not prevent you from using the Service.
cookies.s4.heading: Browser settings
cookies.s4.p: Most browsers also let you block or delete cookies from their privacy settings. This global blocking may degrade some features, in particular keeping your session active.
